_instructions: Copy to output/review_evidence.json only when performing independent review. Use the full SHA256 of the actual final.mp4. After viewing/listening, replace each result with passed only if that check passed, name the reviewer, cite evidence, and record the genuinely checked intervals as [[start_seconds,end_seconds],...]. Intervals must cover the entire final artifact to complete this gate. A render success or an FFmpeg scan is not visual or listening review. Leave unperformed checks as not_reviewed. Never manufacture review records.

checks.notes: Review the composed final picture, framing, captions, edits, and relevant story/visual agreement. Media-capable model review may use media_model_frame_review with recorded evidence.
Listen to the final mix, dialogue boundaries, narration tails and synchronization. A listening-capable model may use media_model_listen with recorded evidence.
